children: Shares of investment banking firm Evercore

jumped 6.3% in the afternoon session after the company was named as a financial advisor to Lumentum in its definitive agreement to be acquired by Marvell Technology in an all-stock transaction with an implied enterprise value of $115 billion.

Under the definitive agreement, Citigroup Global Markets is also serving alongside the company as a financial advisor to Lumentum. The transaction is structured as an all-stock deal in which Lumentum stockholders will receive 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock owned.
What is the market telling us

Evercore’s shares are not very volatile and have only had 8 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful, although it might not be something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 19 days ago when the stock dropped 3.1% on the news that September consumer price inflation accelerated to 3.7% and core inflation topped estimates, reigniting concerns over Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. The hotter-than-expected data showed headline consumer prices rising 3.7% annually, while core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, reached 2.6%. In the wake of the report, traders raised the implied probability of a central bank rate increase at the next meeting to nearly 44%. The sudden shift in policy expectations pushed Treasury yields higher and triggered volatility across bond markets.
When borrowing costs remain high and unpredictable, corporations typically hold off on mergers, acquisitions, and debt offerings, creating broad sector-wide pressure on investment banking revenue.

Evercore is down 12.1% since the beginning of the year, and at $308.94 per share, it is trading 19.4% below its 52-week high of $383.12 from January 2026. Despite the year-to-date decline, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Evercore’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at an investment worth $2,029.
